name: What is the difference between renovating and remodeling an interior space?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between renovating and remodeling an interior space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovation typically involves restoring an existing space to its original condition or updating its finishes without changing the layout, such as repainting or replacing flooring. Remodeling, on the other hand, involves altering the structure or layout of a space, like moving walls, reconfiguring a kitchen, or adding new rooms. While both can improve a home's aesthetics and functionality, remodeling often requires more extensive planning and permits due to structural changes. Understanding this distinction is crucial for defining project scope and budget. When working with Maine Results, Inc., we help clarify whether your vision falls under renovation or remodeling for accurate planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation updates finishes without changing layout; remodeling alters structure or layout. Remodeling usually requires more planning and permits.
